input: Enroll in a professional bookkeeping short course online

gold.taskTitle: Enroll in an online professional bookkeeping course
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and enroll in a professional bookkeeping short course offered online.

questions.title: What is your current bookkeeping or accounting skill level?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a complete beginner, has some basic knowledge, or is looking to formalize existing experience.

questions.title: Do you need a recognized certificate upon completion?
questions.description: Determine whether official accreditation or a certificate from a professional body is required for the user's goals.

questions.title: What is your budget for this course?
questions.description: Establish a spending range to filter free, low-cost, or premium course options.

questions.title: When do you want to start and finish the course?
questions.description: Identify the user's desired start date and how quickly they want to complete the course.

questions.title: How many hours per week can you dedicate to studying?
questions.description: Gauge available study time to match the user with a course that fits their schedule and pace.

questions.title: Is this course for personal use or a specific job role?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user needs bookkeeping skills for their own business, a career change, or a specific employer requirement.

questions.title: Are there specific software tools you need to learn?
questions.description: Find out if the user needs training in particular tools such as QuickBooks, Xero, or MYOB as part of the course.
